mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS sourceId,r.projectCode AS rawProjectCode, latest.id AS canonicalSourceId, latest.`dataSource` AS sourceSystem, latest.`orderExecNumber` AS executionNo, latest.`projectCode` AS projectCode, latest.`projectName` AS projectName, latest.`salesManCode` AS salesRepCode, latest.`salesManName` AS salesRepName, latest.`marketCode` AS marketCode, latest.`marketName` AS marketName, latest.`systemId` AS systemSourceKey, latest.`systemName` AS systemName, latest.`expendId` AS expendSourceKey, latest.`expendName` AS expendName, latest.`industryId` AS industryCode, latest.`industryName` AS industryName, latest.`officeCode` AS departmentCode, latest.`officeName` AS departmentName, latest.`serviceTypeName` AS serviceTypeName, latest.`channelName` AS channelName, latest.`engineeFee` AS engineeringFeeRaw, latest.`objId` AS sourceObjectId, latest.`applyType` AS applyType, latest.`corporationCode` AS companyCode, latest.`customerProjectName` AS customerProjectName, latest.`finalCustomerName` AS finalCustomerName, latest.`agentName` AS agentName, latest.`majorProjectLevel` AS majorProjectLevel, latest.`projectMoney` AS projectAmount, latest.`submitTime` AS submitTime, latest.`predBidDate` AS predictedBidTime, latest.`linkmanName` AS contactName, latest.`linkmanTel` AS contactPhone FROM pm_project_property_from_sms r JOIN (SELECT CAST(dataSource AS BINARY) AS systemKey,CAST(orderExecNumber AS BINARY) AS executionKey,MAX(id) AS canonicalId FROM pm_project_property_from_sms GROUP BY CAST(dataSource AS BINARY),CAST(orderExecNumber AS BINARY)) chosen ON chosen.systemKey <=> CAST(r.dataSource AS BINARY) AND chosen.executionKey <=> CAST(r.orderExecNumber AS BINARY) JOIN pm_project_property_from_sms latest ON latest.id=chosen.canonicalId ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.projectCode,'-',1) FROM pm_project p JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS canonicalId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) chosen ON chosen.canonicalId=p.projectId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND p.projectType='10' AND p.projectCode IS NOT NULL LIMIT #{limit}
